description: Versioned contract for one `protofuzz scan --json` finding. Enforced deterministically by pfg_core::findings::validate_finding. Bump schema_version on any breaking change.

file.description: Path of the scanned .proto file, as passed on the command line.

message.description: Human-readable finding text. Capped (not truncated) at MAX_MESSAGE_LEN.

pattern_id.description: Id of the attributed CVE/RUSTSEC pattern, or null when the finding is structural. When present it must name a pattern in the pfg_core::patterns registry.

span.description: Byte span of the offending construct, or null when unknown.

title: protobuf-fuzz-guard finding
